def transform(grid):
    from collections import deque

    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    bg = max(range(10), key=lambda color: sum(v == color for row in grid for v in row))

    seen = set()
    components = []
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color == bg or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            q = deque([(r, c)])
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = []
            while q:
                y, x = q.popleft()
                cells.append((y, x))
                for dy, dx in ((1, 0), (-1, 0), (0, 1), (0, -1)):
                    ny, nx = y + dy, x + dx
                    if (0 <= ny < h and 0 <= nx < w and
                            (ny, nx) not in seen and grid[ny][nx] == color):
                        seen.add((ny, nx))
                        q.append((ny, nx))
            components.append((color, cells))

    def l_bounds(cells):
        ys = [r for r, c in cells]
        xs = [c for r, c in cells]
        r0, r1, c0, c1 = min(ys), max(ys), min(xs), max(xs)
        if r0 == r1 or c0 == c1:
            return None
        s = set(cells)
        for r in (r0, r1):
            for c in (c0, c1):
                shape = ({(y, c) for y in range(r0, r1 + 1)} |
                         {(r, x) for x in range(c0, c1 + 1)})
                if s == shape:
                    return r1 - r0 + 1, c1 - c0 + 1
        return None

    markers = [(i, l_bounds(cells)) for i, (_, cells) in enumerate(components)]
    markers = [(i, dims) for i, dims in markers if dims is not None]
    if not markers:
        return out

    marker_i, (mh, mw) = max(markers, key=lambda item: len(components[item[0]][1]))
    marker_color = components[marker_i][0]

    # The marked L specifies the scale; recolor the component whose bounding
    # dimensions most closely match half the marker's dimensions.
    candidates = []
    for i, (color, cells) in enumerate(components):
        if i == marker_i:
            continue
        ys = [r for r, c in cells]
        xs = [c for r, c in cells]
        ch, cw = max(ys) - min(ys) + 1, max(xs) - min(xs) + 1
        score = abs(ch - mh / 2) + abs(cw - mw / 2)
        candidates.append((score, i))

    if candidates:
        _, target_i = min(candidates)
        for r, c in components[target_i][1]:
            out[r][c] = marker_color

    return out
